verdict.rationale: Docs show Bitbucket supports third-party integrations (Snyk security scans, Jira Service Management, Bamboo/Jenkins CI/CD, third-party code reports) and access to AI models via Rovo, indicating some ecosystem extensibility. However, there's no explicit mention of an app marketplace, catalog of third-party apps/actions, or independent corroboration of a marketplace ecosystem comparable to competitors. Missing for 10: explicit marketplace/app store documentation, breadth of third-party app catalog, and independent hands-on evidence of installing marketplace apps.
